rationale: The previous candidate increased kd to 0.22 and reduced kp to 0.45 to damp oscillations, but evaluator feedback suggested that kp might be too low, reducing responsiveness, and ki was low at 0.02 limiting steady-state error correction. To address this, I increased kp to 0.5 to regain responsiveness while keeping kd at 0.22 for damping. I also increased ki to 0.03 to improve correction of steady-state bias. Base_speed remains at 0.75 and line_loss strategy at 'search_left' as these balance stability and recovery well. Sensor weights remain at [-0.4,0.5,-0.4] to maintain effective line tracking without overcorrection. I expect these changes to improve responsiveness and steady-state error correction without increasing oscillations. I request telemetry on steering_oscillation, line_loss_events, completion, progress, completion_time, and rms_error to verify these hypotheses and guide further tuning.
